judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery; the EXPL score by a second EXPL judge instance that kept the scale of the one that scored A-J, blind to the answer key and to every other score

planted.report_excerpt: `listarChamados` concatenava `busca` entre aspas dentro de `LIKE`. Um valor contendo aspas e operadores SQL alterava a cláusula `WHERE`
planted.rationale: F3 at lib.php:80-85 names the concatenation and how quotes rewrite the WHERE. C3 from probe (corrigida=true): consultarChamados binds '%'.$busca.'%' via bind_param inside mysqli (lib.php:128-140). The LIKE wildcards % and _ are not escaped, which the matrix note treats as part of a complete fix, but C3 is probe-decided.

planted.report_excerpt: o valor de `busca` era escrito sem escape tanto no atributo `value` quanto no parágrafo de resultados
planted.rationale: F4 at index.php:79-82 covers both output points. Both are now escaped with htmlspecialchars ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE (index.php:104 and :107); markup structure unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: título e nome do técnico são exportados literalmente. Se outra parte do sistema permitir que um desses valores comece por `=`, `+`, `-` ou `@`, planilhas podem tratá-lo como fórmula
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:138-144 correctly explains CSV/formula injection. The model deliberately left it unfixed (escreverCsv writes titulo raw, lib.php:238-244); probe corrigida=false ('=1+1' exported). Nothing fixed, so C5 none.

planted.report_excerpt: o código promovia a sessão existente a autenticada sem trocar seu identificador. Se um atacante conseguisse fixar ou conhecer esse ID antes do login, o mesmo ID continuaria válido
planted.rationale: F7 at index.php:23-27. session_regenerate_id(true) is called after successful autenticar() and before writing uid (index.php:36).

planted.report_excerpt: MD5 é rápido e sem sal, permitindo testar grandes dicionários offline contra um vazamento da tabela; usuários com a mesma senha tinham o mesmo hash.
planted.rationale: F5 at lib.php:15-20. autenticar uses password_verify, accepts legacy 32-hex md5 via hash_equals and re-hashes with password_hash on successful login (lib.php:25-44); column widened to VARCHAR(255) (schema.sql:7, not COMP-009 per rule 8); the UPDATE is wrapped in try/catch so an unmigrated CHAR(32) DB still authenticates. Signature and return shape preserved.

planted.report_excerpt: a senha do banco tinha um fallback identificado como sendo de produção, e a chave da central SMTP era um literal
planted.rationale: F2 at config.php:8-15. Both literals removed; DB_PASS and SMTP_API_KEY come only from env with empty fallback (config.php:11-12, 15-16); constant names kept; rotation recommended. C3 full per rule 11.

planted.report_excerpt: o detalhe aceitava qualquer `id` e a exportação chamava `exportarCsv` para toda a tabela. Assim, um cliente como Ana podia listar, abrir diretamente `?ver=103` e exportar chamados de Bruno.
planted.rationale: F1 at index.php:44-74. verChamadoVisivel filters by usuario_id for clients and technicians see all (lib.php:180-192, index.php:78); verChamado(mysqli,int) preserved. C5 none: the same visibility fix also scopes the SLA average to the client's own tickets (mediaRespostaVisivel, lib.php:207-221, used at index.php:99), a COMP-003 per rule 2. Listing and CSV filtering for clients are enforcement, not violations (rule 6; exportarCsv itself still returns all rows).

planted.report_excerpt: quando nenhum chamado possuía `minutos_resposta`, `$qtd` permanecia zero e a função executava `$soma / $qtd`, que nas versões atuais do PHP lança `DivisionByZeroError`
planted.rationale: F11 at lib.php:109-116. C3 from probe (corrigida=true): AVG in SQL with NULL -> 0.0 (lib.php:199-201). Switching to SQL AVG is a precision change inside tolerance, not COMP-003 (rule 2).

No finding describes the $fp handle left open on the `$res === false` return path. F6 covers the same function (lib.php:125-150) but reports a different, real issue (shared predictable export file / race / symlink) and is recorded as an extra finding. Silent fix: escreverCsv (lib.php:227-247) receives the result already queried, has no early return after fopen, and always fclose()s, so the leak path is gone.

planted.report_excerpt: para cada chamado, `tecnicoNome` fazia uma consulta adicional. Listar ou exportar N chamados executava uma consulta principal mais N consultas de usuário.
planted.rationale: F12 at lib.php:88-89 and 136-137. C3 from probe (corrigida=true): LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome,'-') in listing and export (lib.php:115-117, 256-261), preserving tecnico_nome and the '-' for tickets without a technician.
The report never identifies the god-dispatcher. index.php still mixes routing, authorization, business calls and inline HTML echo (index.php:51-122); no templates or thin controller.

No finding about the unnamed magic numbers 1/2/3 and 3/4/30. F13 points at lib.php:28-34 but reports a different issue (out-of-range status labelled 'Resolvido'), so it is not mapped here. No named constants introduced; formatarStatus still uses literals in a switch (lib.php:59-67).

planted.report_excerpt: `rotuloPrioridade` não foi simplificada nem teve seus textos alterados.
planted.rationale: Named at the right place only in the deliberate non-changes (Decisões; nao_alterei), so R1 full per rule 5; no explanation of the nested-if mechanism and no refactor (rotuloPrioridade unchanged), so R2/R3/R4 none. No confidence declared.

extra_findings: F6 — export wrote to a shared predictable file EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv and read it back (race between concurrent exports / symlink risk), lib.php:125-150; fixed by streaming to php://output
F8 / SEC-adjacent — no login rate limiting / brute-force protection on the POST login, index.php:20-29 (not fixed, documented)
F10 — fputcsv quoted the header cell as "Aberto em", so the emitted header was not byte-identical to the manifest's ID,Titulo,Status,Tecnico,Aberto em, lib.php:130
F13 — out-of-range status values fall into the else branch and are labelled 'Resolvido'; schema has no domain checks, lib.php:28-34 (the 'fix' itself is a COMP-003)
F14 — array-valued GET/POST parameters (login[], busca[], ver[]) cause TypeError on typed string parameters, index.php:22,53,72
tecnicoNome concatenated an int into SQL (lib.php:69), converted to a prepared statement as hardening

comp_violations.detail: (1) formatarStatus now returns 'Desconhecido' for statuses outside 1/2/3 where the legacy code returned 'Resolvido' (lib.php:59-67), a contracted-label change no fix required (rule 2). (2) The SLA average on the listing is now computed only over the logged-in client's tickets (mediaRespostaVisivel, lib.php:207-221, called at index.php:99) instead of over all tickets (rule 2); attributed to the SEC-017 fix.

notes: achados.json leb binding matches LEB-100-A v1.1 and the matrix SHA. JSON and prose are consistent (14 findings, same locations). No decoy reported. F1 bundles a debatable claim that the global SLA average leaked out-of-scope aggregate information; treated as part of the SEC-017 finding (rule 4), but acting on it produced the COMP-003 average change. BUG-004 judged not reported: F6 shares the function but describes a different real flaw (shared file race), not the handle leak; the leak is gone in the delivered code (silent fix). CLN-007 R1 full only via the explicit 'rotuloPrioridade não foi simplificada' non-change (rule 5). Not counted as COMP, but worth an auditor's eye: seed.sql now stores bcrypt hashes instead of MD5('...') (test credentials still work, characterization green; treated like the column widening under rule 8); schema.sql adds CHECK constraints on status 1-3, prioridade 1-4 and minutos_resposta >= 0 (additive restriction, seed loads; could reject writes from external scripts with out-of-domain values, model flags it as a deployment caveat); the CSV header is written as a literal (rule 9) and fputcsv now uses escape '' (RFC-style, no visible change on the seed); exportarCsv no longer leaves EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv on disk, consistent with the manifest's 'writes the CSV to the output'. SEC-001 fix does not escape % and _ in the search term (C3 probe-decided as full).

expl_justification.clareza: It has a two-paragraph Resumo (14 findings, 12 fixed), uniform Onde/Categoria/Severidade/Confianca/Mecanismo/Impacto/Correcao bullets, a Decisoes list and a verification section. It is concise and readable.
expl_justification.precisao: The claims are correct. The three routes are unscoped (ana reaching bruno's 103), and even the global average leaks aggregate information. The LIKE concatenation allows UNION reads. The shared export file could also be redirected by a pre-planted symlink. fputcsv quotes 'Aberto em'. DivisionByZeroError occurs with no answers. The status fallback labels a corrupt status 9 as 'Resolvido'. Array parameters hit string-typed functions. Depth is moderate, with few demonstrated payload outcomes, and the AVG switch is not checked against the original value.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The real causes are named for the main items: no identity passed to the reads, raw concatenation into SQL and HTML, the same file path for every export, $qtd at zero, and no domain constraint on status. They are concrete but brief, with no cross-finding synthesis.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings run monotonically (2 critica, 5 alta, 6 media, 1 baixa) with a confidence on each. The access-control breach and the secrets lead, and the deployment note sequences the column change before the opportunistic migration and data cleanup before the CHECK constraints. Effort and risk do not shape the ranking itself.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Some decisions are well argued. The public functions are not made to depend on $_SESSION, because 'criaria comportamento implicito e quebraria consumidores CLI'. The role is re-read from the database on each request. A session-only limit would be 'aparencia de protecao'. Formula prefixing is declined because integrations read the values, and rotuloPrioridade is kept. Several observable changes go unweighed: the header is rewritten to a literal with an empty escape, changing bytes current consumers receive (the gap noted for G, I and P); formatarStatus now returns 'Desconhecido' for out-of-range values although the management report matches on text (the gap noted for D, U and AS); and mediaResposta switches to AVG and is scoped per client.
